description: Browse prompt templates, workflows, tables and evaluations, or run a PromptLayer workflow.

promptlayer_new_table_trigger.description: Runs for each new table in PromptLayer. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, workspace_id, title, folder_id, sheet_count, created_at, updated_at

promptlayer_new_template_trigger.description: Runs for each new prompt template in PromptLayer. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, prompt_name, prompt_template.content, prompt_template.input_variables, prompt_template.template_format, prompt_template.type, metadata.model, commit_message, llm_kwargs, version, external_ids, is_snippet

promptlayer_new_workflow_trigger.description: Runs for each new workflow in PromptLayer. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, workspace_id, user_id, name, is_deleted, latest_version_number, release_labels, external_ids

promptlayer_template_version_changed_tri.description: Runs each time a prompt template version changes in PromptLayer. Changes made before the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, prompt_name, prompt_template.content, prompt_template.input_variables, prompt_template.template_format, prompt_template.type, metadata.model, commit_message, llm_kwargs, version, external_ids, is_snippet

promptlayer_workflow_version_changed_tri.description: Runs each time a workflow version changes in PromptLayer. Changes made before the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, workspace_id, user_id, name, is_deleted, latest_version_number, release_labels, external_ids
